about.acknowledgements: Hangaia ki te ❤️ mō te pūmanawa tuwhera — ngā mihi ki te kaupapa FFmpeg me tōna hapori.
app.name: EncodeX
batchQueue.remuxContainerHint: Te ipu ka tāruatia ngā awa ki roto. "Aunoa" ka pupuri i te taapiri o ia kōnae taketake.
convert.customChainHint: Kīanga tātari FFmpeg kua wehea ki ngā piko. Ko ia tūemi me whai piko porohita me piko tapawhā rite, ngā tohutohu aruaru kua hāngai, ā, kāore he tohu matapae o te raki.
convert.filtersCopyWarning: Kua whakahohe te aratau tārua kore-ngaro, nō reira ka warewarehia ngā tātari ataata. Whakaweto te tārua kore-ngaro ki te whakamahi i ngā tātari.
convert.filtersDisabledNote: Me whakawaehere anō ngā tātari ataata. Whakaweto te tārua kore-ngaro ki te tāpiri tātari.
convert.filtersHint: Whakamahi i ngā tātari ataata FFmpeg (tapahi, reiti anga, whakaware-ā-rawhi, whakaiti haruru, tae…) i te wa o te whakawaehere. Ka whakakotahitia ngā tātari katoa ki tētahi meinga -vf kotahi i muri i te tauine me te hurihuri.
convert.noFilters: Kāore anō he tātari kia tāpiritia.
dashboard.descDemux: Wehewehea ngā awa o tētahi kōnae ki ngā kōnae putanga motuhake
dashboard.descRemux: Nekehia ngā awa kore-ngaro ki tētahi ipu hou
demux.audioCodecHint: Te āhua o te tuhituhi i ngā awa oro. "Tārua" ka tango i a rātou kore-ngaro me te kore whakawaehere anō; ko te kōwhiri kōdeka ka whakawaehere anō i te oro.
demux.bitmapSubtitleWarning: Kāore tēnei awa hauraro-raraunga (bitmap) e taea te huri ki tuhinga me te kore OCR, nō reira ka tangohia hei tārua .mks kore-ngaro.
demux.cancelMessage: Kei te tino hiahia whakakore i te Demux o nāianei?
demux.dropLabel: Tōia he kōnae ataata ki konei, ka pāwhiri rānei ki te kōwhiri
demux.filtersHint: Whakamahi i ngā tātari ataata FFmpeg (tapahi, reiti anga, whakaware-ā-rawhi, whakaiti haruru, tae…) i te wa o te whakawaehere anō i te awa ataata kua kōwhiria. He kore-ngaro te "Tārua", nō reira ka puta noa ngā tātari ina whakawaehere anō te ipu whāinga i te ataata.
demux.filtersIgnoredCopy: Ka warewarehia ngā tātari ataata i te mea he "Tārua" te whāinga ataata, nā te mea e kore e taea te tārua awa kia whakawaehere anō. Kōwhiria he ipu whāinga kia whakamahia ai ngā tātari.
demux.outputDirHint: Ko te kōpaki e tuhia ai ngā awa i tangohia. Ko te taunoa ko te kōpaki o te kōnae taketake.
demux.streamsHint: Kōwhiria ngā awa hei tango. Ka noho tētahi kōnae putanga motuhake mō ia awa i kōwhiria; ka pekehia ngā awa kāore i kōwhiria.
demux.subtitleFormatHint: Te āhua o te tuhituhi i ngā awa hauraro. "Tārua" ka tango i a rātou kore-ngaro me te kore whakawaehere anō; ko te kōwhiri hōputu ka huri i te hauraro. Kāore e taea te noho tuhinga o ngā hauraro bitmap (hei tauira PGS/DVDSUB), nō reira ka noho tārua tonu.
demux.subtitleWarningHint: Kāore e taea te whakawaehere i ngā awa hauraro bitmap (hei tauira PGS/DVDSUB) ki tuhinga me te kore OCR, nō reira ka tangohia hei tārua .mks kore-ngaro. I roto i te mahere tango, ka puta hei "Tārua".
demux.summaryHint: Kōnae putanga kotahi mō ia awa i kōwhiria, i te raupapa mahina. Ko ngā kōnae kua tapaina hei "Tārua" ka tangohia kore-ngaro; ko ngā kōnae kua tapaina hei "Huri" ka whakawaehere anō.
demux.title: Demux
demux.videoContainerHint: Te āhua o te tuhituhi i ngā awa ataata. "Tārua" ka tango i a rātou kore-ngaro me te kore whakawaehere anō; ko te kōwhiri ipu ka whakawaehere anō i te ataata ki tērā hōputu.
demux.videoFileHint: Te kōnae pāpāho taketake ka tangohia ai ōna awa. Ka tuhia ia awa i kōwhiria ki tōna ake kōnae putanga.
filters.presets.blurHint: Whakamahi i te pōrekereke pouaka kia māmā ai te atahanga.
filters.presets.colorHint: Whakatikaina te mārama, te rerekētanga, te hārau me te kama (eq).
filters.presets.cropHint: Tapahia te ataata ki te whānui, teitei me ngā tāpae kua tautuhia.
filters.presets.deinterlaceHint: Huri i te ataata rawhi-ruru ki te ataata atanga-whakaroto.
filters.presets.denoiseHint: Whakaiti i te haruru me te pupuri tonu i ngā taipitopito (hqdn3d).
filters.presets.framerateHint: Panoni i te reiti anga putanga (ka tāruaruatia pekehia rānei ngā anga).
filters.presets.grayscaleHint: Tangohia te tae, waiho te ahua pango-mā.
filters.presets.sharpenHint: Piki ake te koi e mōhiotia ana (unsharp).
mediaInfo.subtitle: Hauraro
remux.addedTrackDelayHint: Te tāpae kua tohua mō tēnei rīpene ina whakaritea ki te ataata (pai = purei ā muri). Kore-ngaro: ka whakamahia hei -itsoffset i te tārua o te awa.
remux.audioSyncHint: Nekehia te rīpene oro matua ina whakaritea ki te ataata me te kore whakawaehere anō, hei tauira -0.5 mō te 0.5 hēkona tērā, 1.5 rānei mō te 1.5 hēkona ā muri.
remux.audioSyncLossless: Kore-ngaro: ka tāruatia te oro hei awa me te tāpae-wā, nō reira kāore e panoni te kounga.
remux.audioTracksHint: Ngā kōnae oro ō-roto (.m4a, .aac, .mp3, .flac, .opus, .ogg, .wav) ka whakakuhuna ki te putanga Remux hei rīpene whakauru āpiti.
remux.cancelMessage: Kei te tino hiahia whakakore i te Remux o nāianei?
remux.chaptersHint: Ko te taunoa ka pupuritia ngā upoko o te taketake. Kawemai he kōnae upoko FFMETADATA hei whakakapi i ngā upoko o te taketake i te kōnae i muri i te Remux.
remux.chaptersUnsupported: Kāore e pupuri ana a {{container}} i ngā mōhiohio upoko, nō reira ka maka ngā upoko.
remux.containerHint: Te ipu o te kōnae putanga i muri i te Remux. Kōwhiria mai i ngā ipu ataata noa; ka whai te taapiri putanga i te ipu.
remux.copyChapters: Tārua i ngā upoko o te taketake
remux.copyChaptersHint: Pupuri i ngā tohu upoko o te kōnae taketake i te putanga Remux (kore-ngaro, -map_chapters 0).
remux.dropLabel: Tōia he kōnae ataata ki konei, ka pāwhiri rānei ki te kōwhiri
remux.filtersHint: Whakamahi i ngā tātari ataata FFmpeg i te whakawaehere anō o te awa ataata i kōwhiria. Kāore e taea te whakamahi tātari ki te tārua kore-ngaro, nō reira mā te tāpiri kotahi ka huri tēnei Remux ki te whakawaehere anō.
remux.filtersReencodeWarning: Kāore e taea e ngā tātari ataata te mahi ki te tārua awa, nō reira ka huri ngā tātari i kōwhiria ({{count}}) i tēnei Remux ki te whakawaehere anō.
remux.outputFileHint: Te ara whāinga mō te kōnae i muri i te Remux. Ka whai te taapiri i te ipu whāinga.
remux.streamsHint: Kōwhiria ngā awa mai i te kōnae taketake hei pupuri i te putanga Remux. Ka maka ngā awa kāore i kōwhiria.
remux.subtitleCodecHint: Te kōdeka hauraro mō ngā rīpene kua whakakuhuna. Ka whakaae ngā ipu ki ngā hōputu hauraro rerekē; ko te kōwhiri hōputu e kore e taea e te ipu te pupuri ka puta te whakatūpato.
remux.subtitlesHint: Ngā kōnae hauraro ō-roto (.srt, .ass, .vtt) ka whakakuhuna ki te putanga Remux hei rīpene whakauru āpiti.
remux.thumbnailHint: He atahanga uhi ōmeka (.jpg, .jpeg, .png) ka whakakuhuna ki te kōnae i muri i te Remux. Ka piri a MKV/WebM hei awa atahanga; ka whakakuhuna a MP4/MOV hei awa ataata me te tohu attached_pic.
remux.thumbnailUnsupported: Kāore e taea e {{container}} te pupuri ūpoko. Huri ki MKV, WebM, MP4, MOV rānei kia piri ai te karakaramata.
remux.title: Remux
remux.videoFileHint: Te kōnae pāpāho taketake ka whakakōpaki anō ai ōna awa ki te ipu whāinga. Ka tāruatia ngā awa me te kore whakawaehere anō.
remux.warningsHint: Ngā pitopito kōrero kāore e ākaia ana mō te hononga o ngā awa me ngā tautuhinga kua kōwhiria ki te ipu kua kōwhiria. Ka taea tonu e ngā whakatūpato te tīmata; ka ākaia e ngā hē.
terms.title: Ngā here me ngā tikanga
update.title: Whakahōu
